confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Portugal's price levels, with Coimbra placed somewhat below Lisbon and Porto. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, café and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and varies widely. The FX value comes from search-result snippets of RBA pages dated 2026-10-15; I did not open the RBA F11.1 table itself, so verify it there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Portugal's other mid-sized university and tourist cities (for example Braga and Aveiro), adjusted down from Porto and Lisbon for Coimbra's smaller tourist market. Accommodation is set for July high season.
